title: Record a stream crossing
description: Turn the road’s detected crossing of a stream into a crossing record for planning and pricing.

setup.goal: Record a detected stream crossing and see what it still needs.
audience: Forest road designers new to PGMaps
access: None: the lesson opens the synthetic training project, which needs no sign-in and no data download.
setup.startingScreen: The road designer on the Hillside access training project, at station 0+000 with the cross-section shown.
limitations: The readings are those of the synthetic training terrain and the Hillside access roads as shipped.

overlay.title: Open Engineering
overlay.body: Open the Engineering tab. Its stream crossing summary says whether a detected crossing still needs a record or a price.

overlay.title: Open the crossing estimates
overlay.body: Expand Stream crossing estimates. The road starts with one detected crossing and an unpriced estimate.

overlay.title: Record the crossing
overlay.body: Select Record detected crossings. A record is made for the road’s crossing of Synthetic drainage.

overlay.title: See what still needs a decision
overlay.body: The record is for Synthetic drainage at 600.5 m. Its planning structure option is still Not selected, and its cost items need quantities, rates and a price source: record design and field evidence before choosing or pricing a structure.
